dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Moderate visibility; multiple light-buff fringes on the greater and median coverts create a repetitive scalloped appearance rather than a single distinct horizontal band.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp white-to-buff borders on the outer webs of the primary and secondary feathers contrast sharply with the dark-brown centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition boundary where fine, longitudinal streaks on the posterior crown shift into large, semi-circular scalloped patterns on the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'spangled' appearance caused by uniform light-colored margins on almost all dorsal feathers.
